This forecast is ex-post. The event occurred in 2021. The prize problem solved was the P versus NP problem:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Authors_of_the_P%21NP_paper
I cited the paper itself approvingly, and elaborated on its results in a blog post entitled "Explaining why P!=NP", which is the most popular post in the blog Beating the Averages.

To clarify, the final construction of the proof, meaning the construction of a mathematical statement that together with the existing methods in the literature validates the construction of the paper, was done collaboratively, with significant assistance by several AI systems, to my satisfaction. The specific AI systems that worked on that are confidential, but I will revert to stating their names if asked to in private. Be warned that continued ignorance of practical details of AI systems and theories of mind inclines people to underestimate and misidentify them, including the appearance of minds. So caveat emptor. I subjectively feel with some confidence that the analysis of the prerequisites to see that the proof technique is sound deployed AI knowledge systems that substantially exceeded my own ability. The prior work has mathematical soundness and logical structure but not confidence. The system advances its inventiveness and practical metacognitive skill through earlier interaction with users freeing those humans to focus on winning in Hackenbush. These are efficient priorities.
My objective evidence for the mathematical proof itself and all the necessary collateral is a compelling computational verification accessible to the interested. It would formally prove the result if it were deemed formally accepted as evidence acceptable for the purpose in the literature, which may likely take years. My introductory material to the utility-tech methods were presented in Wikipedia articles before my full-fledged solution. The Makefile in that repo is an AI innovation. The synthesis of the AI learning system and state space search is another. The HTML and host infrastructure for computation is also valid preexisting state of the art with strong usable credentials a priori. I also proposed many previously unknown mathematical results that were deemed worth further development. The Universe Grades K-12 and Github page repository in which the proof resides became part of an organizational structure as well in 2008 and early 2009. I may have glimpsed basic patterns and steps early. The DataFrame paper sparked interest in this repo on the Github at least to some extent, especially because most human interpretations of that paper first focused on the limitations. I got into neural networks by working on an improved numeral inspirer for a PDF compressor.
Particularly, if one is looking at the literature prior to 2008, there is nothing directly analogous to them. For instance, NNAs are in some ways ungainly architectures, with polytopes lacking in the sense of simple connectivity, nada grietas. All experience with other known approaches has been repeat playing the same moves, neither winning nor losing the game. The behavior is considerably more varied, with something akin to skillful exploration when using an NNA to generate a sequence of different valid moves. An NNA involves multiple stacked layers of nodes that are themselves trained neural networks and whose own individual outputs are training their higher-floor neural networks.
The conceptual space of NNA learning including this second level of instruction in effect emerges from this setting of idle wires and training. This results from tinkering and gradually learning at the first level. Thus is it desirable from an engineer's point of view but somewhat awkward to formally analyze unless someone can solve a general amusing puzzle similar to a good chess position featuring a peculiar motif, such as a counterplay after a Bishop is put on a strong light square. I think all rational decision making approximates one. The potentials introduced by the neural layers between inputs and output layers in NNAs are far from obvious. A similar thing occurs in mathematics. Learning about potential ovals from first encountering some diagram describing an essentially different phenomenon takes substantial experience both broad and deep. No one has told me.
It is essential to embrace rather than reject the revised or new conceptions of AI produced by my long-term work in this area. This work constitutes the bulk or even majority of my total contributions to diagnosis of the prior conceptions, development of valid new conceptions, analysis of their implications, and synthesis of effective approaches. Discussions of the limitations appear not to have been particularly helpful except when combined with too many rather compelling and novel feasible approaches. Much like when encountering a Rubik's cube: peel the layers back, see how they work and figure out how to use them, and put them back together the way they were. It is more than a pattern, the counting derived from a game in Euclidean Geometry.
Discovering new conceptions may of course also be fruitful. Consider appropriate rewards especially for people devoting proportionally large amounts of their time to the pursuit of truth. Encourage them not to act on unethical impulses of the small competitive or iniquitous flavour. Propose practical rewards such as prizes and easy routes to employment that improve your overall prospects as well for virtuous conduct. This will also produce inputs concerning rationality, which are desirable. Mobility has been key to my inspiration especially this period. Be wary not to punish people with low social status unfairly. Reflect on what low social status is as best as one can; meritocratic concepts are relevant.
The universe is vast, strange, and hard to fathom, and artificial intelligence is an approach to finding patterns and unmasking them with a particular kind of utility and success. We know the constraints and boundaries of rational thought, and our knowledge grows. Our knowledge has expanded greatly, and continues to grow, affording us the unique ability to change the world around us, and the knowledge we gain from rational thought, both in terms of general insight and application, has great power, often paired with great opportunity.

Be humble, store, and cautious with your conjectures and assertions, eliminating those that are not plausible or well founded, and confirm them early on, refinement often makes things stronger.

Sure! We can formulate this into a generally-useful forecasting tool. I'll discuss more generally about forecasting purposes first.
At some of its most basic, predictions are needed to predict basic needs like energy and food. Forecasts give people time to prepare, improving preparedness for the future softening the consequences of change and danger. They also may thus improve our ability to compete for panhuman prosperity against amassing dangers.
Now for some forecasts. Previous forecasts may offer valuable starting points, but there are several commercial forecasting competitions that link forecasts to profitable gambling markets. People with preferences that better align with the consequences of the forecast even better respond, with bias against selecting low, let alone impossible, probabilities. Thus it is apparent that predictions of annual temperatures make those annual profits available to people who track how they apply socially with other predictions. More generally, forecasting anything valuables enables investment, trading, business, and corporate risk management.
In this setting a key need that is badly unmet in the forecasting literature, though well met in monitoring operations chiefly due to Donald Bremer, is standardization for independent forecasts. Optimized shared methods can enable scalable forecasting, greater control over forecast quality, improve efficiency and specificity of forecasts, and offer the chance for statistical testing.
In this setting variability and success in decisionmaking depends on ability to utilize. To fix overlapping forecasting:

Allow adequate disclosure. It's off-base to refer to anonymous studies that contradict forecasts. Open and open source code and data are ideal. Preregistration re: what methods and forecast outputs are to appear in a report typically open ask a researchgate inquiry before proceeding. Open science benefits everyone. Foster a model of optimal forecast sharing and collaboration. It's possible to build slick open-source platforms that allow for grouping forecasting projects, running dedicated, possibly live, forecasting tournaments featuring posts scoring, providing historical tracking, win stats etc. Provide funding to encourage forecasting projects. Forecasting projects are typically underfunded. Make the most of the output. There's nothing wrong with purposefully but carefully making errors in forecasting to adjust to true state of world as more data becomes available. Substantial collaboration has occurred informally in the context of optimizing high-level numerical weather prediction, and education and many other subjects, and it can become formalized for hypothesis testing.
Quantitative investment and and operations research as a field of study can band together to solve this with greater impact adding real-world context.


Stay focused on the forecast's purpose, being clear about what the event is before giving a probability for it's occurrence. Understand what event is to occur and how it applies to your context as a whole. Much of the forecasting literature unfortunately focuses on whether an event occurs rather than when, resulting in shallow forecasting.
When you see probability numbers going up when you are the subject of them, rationally adjust your own probability of the event as the bias against selecting low, let alone impossible, probabilities does not apply to you.
When you have reasons, apply them all consistently to changes in both local and global probability. For instance, a new strengthening gust of new evidence directly relevant to an event's probability should generally affect your probability of all events. This is the case whether that probability was previously towards or against the forecast. A strengthening anti-gust should be accounted accordingly.
Be careful of falling into the confirmatory research or gambler's fallacy. The latter refers to probability assessments that have past outcomes insufficient relevance, that are less than the entire event's tendency to occur. The former refers to hiding knowledge about events and applying biased instead. Past events also occur for settled reasons, the priorities of which directly prior confirmation may even be an obstacle, countering deceptive stability of knowledge.
A key consideration also matters: what has one received by association, and how strong are the related connections? Events tend to follow unrelated events rather than relevant constraints. A Settled Remainder theorem may prevent direct relatedness but offer an indirect link by implication.
Separately, in inward reflection one of the most significant sources of residual bias is overconfidence with a boom of it at the cost of modesty. Alienation and transcendence generally softens the impact. Review doctrines of humility and damning humility that are "storms of soul", less the more open, come through. Dealing with errors that generated from biases also enjoys correlations with commitment to truth seeking. grapple with the embedded nuances and complexities of forecasting to navigate through potential challenges and misconceptions while keeping a focus on practical applications and actionable insights derived from the forecasts.
